answer: Each identity locks 70 credits on a cedar sapling. A random beacon calls a simultaneous ritual; each identity has 10 minutes to sign a quill record of its cedar ring count, audited on the cedar table. Missing, late, or copied records burn it. At 40+6(k-1) each, 1,000 fake identities pay 3,037,000 plus 70,000 locked; no operator can do 1,000 rituals in 10 minutes. A rented-ritual ring burns both. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its bond.
